Gallery of Confessions

Turning private confessions into unique artistic artifacts.

Role
Personal project
Context
Independent

Overview

Gallery of Confessions is a hobby project where people turn their private confessions into artistic artifacts. I built it with Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, using generative AI as part of the creative experience.

My contributions

  • Build the experience using Google AI Studio and the Gemini API.
  • Use Firebase Firestore for data storage.
  • Integrate augmented reality for an immersive way to experience the artwork.
  • Deploy the application on Google Cloud Run.

Exploring AI and interaction

The project brings together generative AI, persistent data storage, and augmented reality in a deployed application.

It gave me a way to explore an idea outside my professional projects and carry it through implementation and deployment.

Technologies

  • Google AI Studio
  • Gemini API
  • Firebase Firestore
  • Google Cloud Run
  • Augmented reality
